sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the dark lightning spirits of Immernachtreich shall heed the call of their Prinzessin and indwell the enchanted arrowhead. When fully indwelt, the Rachsüchtig Blitz shall deal immense Electro DMG.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Nightrider
_curatorNotes: Oz tick: gcsim ozTickInterval=59f (=0.983s), firstTick=64f post-spawn (=1.067s). Multiplier birdAtk at TalentLvl 10 = 159.84% ATK Electro. Per-tick damage authored as a `summonTick` effect on the summon (P3); the timeline renders one marker per tick on the summon bar.
A6 rigor 2026-07-12: scaling corrected 247.32 → 159.84 (gcsim birdAtk[9]=1.5984; genshin-db sidecar Oz's ATK DMG L10 159.8%). Prior 247.32 matched no Fischl multiplier at any level.
abilities.description:
Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing Electro DMG in a small AoE.
For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with Freikugel.

Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
Press again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.

abilities.name: Midnight Phantasmagoria
_curatorNotes: Migration note (2026-04-28): Fischl Q has two phases — (1) a 10s Fischl-as-Oz caster stance with movement buff and collision DMG, (2) Oz remains on field after Q ends. Currently modeled as a single Oz summon mirroring the pre-summons[] shape. After renderer is taught about summons[], reviewer should split into a stance window + post-Q Oz summon.
Oz tick (P3): same 59f interval as the skill-spawned Oz; gcsim burstShortOzFirstTick=63f (≈1.05s) for the swap-cancelled path. Per-tick damage authored as `summonTick` effect on the summon.
A6 rigor 2026-07-12: scaling corrected 247.32 → 159.84 (gcsim queueOz Mult=birdAtk[9]=1.5984; same Oz per-tick multiplier as the skill).
abilities.description:
Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
·Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
·Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing Electro DMG to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
·Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.

passives.name: Stellar Predator
passives.description: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

passives.name: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
passives.caveat: Not modeled: the extra Electro DMG when the active character triggers an Electro reaction while Oz is on the field. Oz's ~1s cadence usually reacts first, and it doesn't fire on Oz's own reactions.
passives.description: If your current active character triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals Electro DMG equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.
_curatorNotes: Not modelled. In practice Oz's ~1s attack cadence frequently steals the electro reaction before the active character can make it. A4 does not proc when Oz himself causes the reaction, making reliable activation highly aura-dependent and off-field-Fischl compositions rarely benefit. Revisit if on-field Fischl archetypes become relevant.

[A7] Dropped the concluding note that the A4 passive is unreliable in most off-field Fischl comps; this conclusion follows from the two kept reasons (Oz steals the reaction / doesn't proc on Oz's own reactions) and is already recorded in the existing curator note.

constellations.name: Gaze of the Deep
constellations.description: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

constellations.name: Devourer of All Sins
constellations.description: When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: Wings of Nightmare
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
_curatorNotes: C4 heal (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim burst.go:68-76 Heal Src=0.2*MaxHP, Target=self, fired 1 frame after Oz spawn (burst.go:116-119) — i.e. at burst-cast end, so onCast is faithful. Fixed 20% (not talent-scaled). Hosted on the constellation entry (not the burst) so no base-kit heal tag/capability is implied below C4. The C4's other half (222% ATK Electro AoE on cast, gcsim burst.go:62 Mult 2.22) is not authored — damage-focused, out of this heal finding's scope.

When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

constellations.name: Against the Fleeing Light

constellations.name: Evernight Raven
constellations.description: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.

factionBonuses.name: Secret Rite
factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, triggering an Electro reaction grants ATK% (overloaded) or EM (electroCharged / lunarCharged) to self and active character for 10s.
